approved_experiment.model: sleep_weekday_min ~ commute_5h + sex + commute_5h x sex + approved covariates
approved_experiment.engine: deterministic ExperimentRunner, weighted_linear_regression with binary moderator interaction

constraints: PROP-003 tests H3: heterogeneity by sex in the commute_5h-sleep_weekday_min association.
This experiment does NOT resolve the inconclusive ranking across personal-time outcomes.
The sentence suggesting it could explain the overall ranking uncertainty is not endorsed by the human review.
The stated reason for deprioritizing PROP-008 is considered weak and is not necessary for approving PROP-003.
An interaction interval containing zero must be interpreted as INCONCLUSIVE, not as evidence of no difference.
All interpretations remain observational and non-causal.

not_endorsed.text: It has the highest expected information gain (HIGH) and can discriminate whether the observed strongest negative point estimate for sleep varies by sex, which could explain the inconclusive ranking of personal‑time dimensions
not_endorsed.reason: An interaction test on sleep does not explain or resolve the cross-outcome ranking uncertainty.
